broad_core_role: universal candidate generator and stable general ranker; never counted as an expert

families.routing: query-conditioned applicability plus bounded nonnegative strength
query-conditioned applicability plus bounded nonnegative strength
families.pocket_role: applicability/confidence evidence; missing pocket is absence of evidence, never negative evidence
families.missing_policy: available members only; silent if none

families.role: integrated scenario-specific correction; all specialists belong to the final system and are dynamically gated per query

specialists.evaluation: official EnzymeCAGE P450 family test set
official EnzymeCAGE phosphatase family test set
official EnzymeCAGE terpene family test set

specialists.activation: TPS scenario only; frozen TPS-reaction-manifold gate for automatic use
specialists.evaluation: TPS specialist validation plus no-regression check on the overall seven-cell suite

families.cross_scenario_policy: all specialists remain available to the integrated system; a specialist contributes exactly zero when its applicability gate does not admit the query
families.general_router_role: separate from the general functional/structural gate; family information is used to activate the matching specialist, not to retune general expert weights
families.specialist_gate: P450/phosphatase/terpene use a reaction-only applicability selector plus reaction-family and pair-level family agreement; TPS uses the frozen TPS reaction-manifold gate

router.specialist_score: general_score + matching scenario specialist correction only when that scenario is active
general_gate_inputs: cached pocket support at multiple shortlist depths
train-only PCA of Broad reaction embedding
router.tps_gate: frozen TPS-reaction-manifold gate when TPS scenario is inferred automatically
router.specialist_gate: P450/phosphatase/terpene: reaction applicability selector + reaction-family winner + pair-level family winner agreement; TPS: TPS reaction-manifold gate

ablation_contract.test_suite: fixed complete seven-cell broad suite for general categories, plus official matching scenario tests for the domain-specialization category
ablation_contract.expensive_scoring: score/cache each expert once; derive leave-one-category-out variants offline whenever candidate pools match

evaluation_protocol.overall_test: the fixed complete seven-cell broad suite; use it to measure overall performance and verify that adding the specialist layer does not degrade the general system

family_specialist_tests.p450: official EnzymeCAGE P450 family test set
family_specialist_tests.phosphatase: official EnzymeCAGE phosphatase family test set
family_specialist_tests.cage_terpene: official EnzymeCAGE terpene family test set
family_specialist_tests.tps: project TPS specialist test/validation protocol plus the overall seven-cell no-regression check

evaluation_protocol.selection_rule: each specialist is retained because it improves its matching specialist benchmark; in the fixed seven-cell overall test all specialists remain attached to the same system and contribute only when their frozen applicability gate fires
evaluation_protocol.overall_guardrail: the integrated system with all domain specialists attached must not degrade aggregate performance on the fixed seven-cell overall test
